faq_heading: 2 bedroom condos in Tsawwassen: your questions answered

faq.q: What do 2 bedroom condos sell for in Tsawwassen?
faq.a: Of the 2 bedroom condos in Tsawwassen, 68 sold over the past year at a median of $614,000, with the middle half between $538,750 and $677,250.

faq.q: How fast do 2 bedroom condos sell in Tsawwassen?
faq.a: The median was 44 days, and homes sold for 96.7% of the list price at a median.

faq.q: Where in Tsawwassen do most 2 bedroom condos sell?
faq.a: Tsawwassen North, with 20 of the 68 sales at a median of $627,500.

faq.q: Which buildings in Tsawwassen have 2 bedroom condos for sale most often?
faq.a: By sales over the past year: Windsor Woods (6 sales, median $557,500); Salt & Meadow (6 sales, median $481,960); Fairview 56 (4 sales); Sandollar (3 sales).

faq.q: What is the strata fee on a 2 bedroom condo in Tsawwassen?
faq.a: The median strata fee on the 2 bedroom condos that sold in Tsawwassen was $541 a month. Fees vary by building, so check the building's own figure.

blocks.text: How 2 bedroom condos in Tsawwassen compare
A 2 bedroom condo in Tsawwassen sold for $214,000 more at the median than a 1 bedroom one ($614,000 against $400,000, 22 sales). The strata fee was $541 a month against $368.
A 2 bedroom condo in Tsawwassen sold for $380,950 less at the median than a 3 bedroom or larger one ($614,000 against $994,950, 6 sales). The strata fee was $541 a month against $833.
Of the 9 cities with 2 bedroom condo pages, Tsawwassen has the highest median price. Chilliwack is lowest at $383,000 and Tsawwassen highest at $614,000.
